verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents broad programmatic coverage. The CLI and API handle project creation and management, rows, files, users, and function deployment ([appwrite-docs-12]), and the CLI runs headless for automation ([appwrite-docs-42]). Storage has full CRUD APIs ([appwrite-docs-10]), messaging is exposed through SDK methods ([appwrite-docs-49]), and an MCP server lets LLMs operate on the API ([appwrite-docs-11], [appwrite-docs-38]). However, no source explicitly claims Console/API parity, and several features are described only as Console actions: social providers, auth settings and topics ([appwrite-docs-45], [appwrite-docs-44], [appwrite-docs-50]). Missing for 10: an explicit statement or evidence of full UI-to-API parity, a published OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path (all probed paths returned 404, [appwrite-probe-3]), and confirmation that Console-only settings such as OAuth provider and auth-method toggles are available via API.
